full_prompt_en: A square painterly digital portrait shows a young silver-haired woman in dark formal clothing against a muted gray wall. The background is a broad, scuffed field of warm gray and charcoal, with vertical scratches and rough brush marks visible around the head and shoulders. Just behind the upper left of her head, a thin irregular ring of antique gold catches small fragments of light. The woman occupies the center and left of the frame in a three-quarter side view, her face turned toward the right and her chin slightly raised. A short, full silver bob curves under the jaw, with a heavy sweep of hair crossing part of the near eye; a dark band holds the hair close to the crown. Her pale face is modeled with small shifts from cool ivory to warm rose, while the nose, lips, lowered gaze, and shadow under the chin remain delicately defined. A white upright collar frames the neck above a dark high neckline. The structured black garment fills the lower frame, its raised shoulder and fitted bodice separated by subtle seams and muted gold embroidery. A small pale inset near the chest provides a crisp accent amid the dense black fabric. The dark clothing merges at its outer edges with the shadowed ground, while the bright hair and face retain sharper, more precise contours. Thin scratchlike marks and broken dry strokes cross the wall, and rougher touches around the gold ring interrupt the otherwise smooth rendering. Soft light arrives from the upper left, grazing the silver strands and forehead and leaving the far side of the neck and clothing in deep, cool shadow. The overall composition is restrained and atmospheric, balancing a luminous pale profile and weathered gold detail against large velvety areas of gray and black.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画笔触的数字肖像呈现一位银发年轻女子，她身穿深色正装，立于低调的灰墙前。背景是暖灰与炭黑组成的宽阔擦磨色域，头肩周围可见纵向刮痕和粗糙笔迹。头部左上后方，一道不规则的古金色细环承接零星亮光。女子占据画面中央和左侧，以四分之三侧面朝右，微微抬起下巴。丰厚的银色短发沿下颌内卷，一束厚发斜过近侧眼睛的一部分；深色发带在头顶固定头发。她的浅色面庞在冷象牙色与暖玫瑰色间微妙过渡，鼻子、嘴唇、垂下的视线及下巴下的阴影都经过细腻界定。直立的白色衣领在深色高领上方框住脖颈。结构鲜明的黑色衣服填满画面下部，隆起的肩部和贴身衣身由细微缝线与低调金色纹饰分开。胸前一小块浅色嵌片在浓黑布料中形成清晰重音。深色衣服的外缘融入阴影背景，明亮头发和面部则保留更锐利、更准确的轮廓。细如刮痕的线迹与断续干笔划过墙面，金色圆环周围更粗的笔触打断了其余部分平滑的塑形。柔光从左上方照来，掠亮银发与额头，使脖颈远侧和衣服陷入偏冷的深影。整体构图克制而富于空气感，以明亮的浅色侧脸和风化金色细节平衡大片天鹅绒般的灰黑区域。
style_prompt_en: The painterly digital finish sets finely modeled pale volumes against deep charcoal masses and an abraded gray ground. Precise edges concentrate around the brightest forms, then soften or break where dark shapes meet darker surroundings. Smooth tonal transitions carry subtle three-dimensional weight, while dry brush scuffs, vertical scratches, and scattered rough marks keep the surface visibly worked. The narrow palette moves through cool ivory, silver gray, warm rose, black, and small tarnished-gold accents; restrained warmth becomes more noticeable because most of the frame is cool and low in saturation. Gentle directional light grazes raised surfaces and falls away quickly into dense shadow. Thin circular and linear accents create a quiet rhythm around a compact focal area, with generous plain ground providing breathing room. The overall effect is intimate and dramatic, combining delicate local rendering with intentionally unfinished, weathered edges.
style_prompt_zh: 带绘画性的数字表面把细腻塑形的浅色体积放在深炭黑块面与擦磨灰底前。精确边缘集中在最明亮的形体周围，深色形状与更暗的环境相接时逐渐柔化或断开。平滑的明度过渡承载微妙立体重量，干笔擦痕、纵向刮线与散落的粗糙笔迹又使表面显出加工痕迹。狭窄色域在冷象牙色、银灰、暖玫瑰、黑色与少量失光古金色间移动；画面大部偏冷且低饱和，使克制的暖色更显眼。柔和的定向光掠过隆起表面，很快衰减入浓重阴影。细圆弧与线性重音围绕紧凑焦点建立安静节奏，宽裕素净的底色留下呼吸空间。整体效果亲密而富戏剧性，把精细的局部塑形与有意保留的风化未完成边缘结合起来。
theme_en: A silver-haired woman in dark formal clothing against a textured gray wall
theme_zh: 银发女子身穿深色正装立于肌理灰墙前
name: WLOP
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
